$comment: What each top-level construct actually emits, classified from compiler behaviour rather than from the parser accepting the keyword. Verified by crates/covenant-driver/tests/capability_registry.rs, which compiles a fixture per construct and asserts the observed behaviour matches the state below. Do not edit by hand without re-running that test: it is the source of truth, this file is the published view.

states.PORTABLE: Builds on every EVM target with byte-identical bytecode. Emits no chain-specific address and no mocked primitive. Deployable on any EVM chain.
states.INCOMPLETE: The construct compiles but does not provide its full declared behaviour: a documented operation is refused. Usable only for the part that works.
states.MOCKED_TESTNET_ONLY: Depends on mocked cryptographic helpers. Testnet-only by construction. Some paths are refused on a helper target until the helper suite is corrected.
states.NO_SYNTHESIS: Parses and passes through unchanged, synthesizing none of the interface the keyword names. Byte-identical to `module`. Emits W606.
states.REFUSED: Does not compile in any form at this release.

$synthesizes: The exact function names the compiler injects, measured by compiling a body that declares no action and no view, so every name listed is synthesized rather than user-written. An empty list means the construct adds nothing to your ABI. `null` means it does not compile. Asserted against the emitted ABI by the same test, which is what stops a note from claiming a surface that is not there.

record.note: No synthesis. Declares storage; you write the actions and views. A field-only record emits an empty ABI over a 12-byte runtime.

token.note: Full ERC-20 surface synthesized, with the Transfer and Approval events.

nft.note: ERC-721 surface synthesized, with the Transfer, Approval and ApprovalForAll events. `safeTransferFrom` is not emitted.

counter.note: No synthesis. No increment or decrement is emitted; write the actions yourself, as with `module`.

module.note: Generic escape hatch, no synthesis by design.

board.note: The post schema compiles, but `append post { .. }` is E430 and any read of `posts` is E431, so a board cannot store or read posts.

market.note: The priority_queue is read-only: .top_key, .top_value, .length exist, .push is E207, so a market cannot accept orders.

vault.note: No reentrancy protection and no value-custody surface. Same body as `module` compiles to identical bytecode. Emits W606.

ballot.note: No voting surface synthesized. Emits W606.

bridge.note: No cross-chain surface synthesized. Emits W606.

confidential token.note: ERC-8227 over mocked FHE. Refused on a helper target (E520) because the encrypted balance check reaches FheCmpGe, which has no deployed helper method.

encrypted counter.note: Mocked FHE counter. Only the revealed field gets an accessor; the increment is yours to write. Builds on sepolia against the deployed FHE helper.

hybrid module.note: Mixed plaintext and mocked-FHE fields. Adds no function of its own; it exists to allow per-field privacy qualifiers. Builds on sepolia against the deployed FHE helper.

ceremony.note: ERC-8228 amnesia over a mocked helper. The destroy path is refused on a helper target (E535) until amnesiaDestroy returns a decodable shape.

registry.note: The ERC-8231 synthesizer injects register/key_of over pq_key, a dynamic ABI type the backend refuses (E505), and the template's own key_of collides (E601). No registry body compiles.
